sections.title: Shields
sections.note: Shields wear out as they block. Gondo repairs them at the Scrap Shop; a Revitalizing Potion does too. The Item Upgrades tracker totals the materials, with its own progress.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.notes: Strength 4, 6 and 8 (hits of one heart it takes before breaking). Wood: safe from electricity, so good in Lanayru, but it burns. Arrows that stick in it can be collected. Rupin's Gear Shop sells it again if it breaks.

tiers.name: Wooden Shield
tiers.howTo: Owlan gives you one outside the Knight Academy once you have the Goddess Sword, or buy it at Rupin's Gear Shop for 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Banded Shield
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Wooden Shield at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 2 Amber Relics, 1 Monster Claw, 1 Jelly Blob and 30 Rupees.

tiers.name: Braced Shield
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Banded Shield at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 3 Amber Relics, 2 Monster Claws, 2 Tumbleweeds, 1 Ornamental Skull and 50 Rupees.

items.name: Iron Shield
items.notes: Strength 6, 9 and 12, the toughest you can break. Iron: fireproof, but conducts electricity unless you Shield Bash it. Zelda Wiki prices the Reinforced Shield at 20 Rupees; Zelda Dungeon and Samurai Gamers say 50.

tiers.name: Iron Shield
tiers.howTo: Buy it at Rupin's Gear Shop for 100 Rupees, on sale after Skyview Temple.

tiers.name: Reinforced Shield
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Iron Shield at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 2 Eldin Ore, 2 Monster Claws, 2 Ornamental Skulls and 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Fortified Shield
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Reinforced Shield at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 3 Eldin Ore, 3 Monster Claws, 3 Tumbleweeds, 1 Blue Bird Feather and 100 Rupees.

items.name: Sacred Shield
items.notes: Strength 2.5, 3.75 and 5, but it slowly repairs itself. Blocks fire, electricity and curses, and Cursed Bokoblins back away from it.

tiers.name: Sacred Shield
tiers.howTo: Buy it at Rupin's Gear Shop for 500 Rupees, on sale after the first battle with the Imprisoned.

tiers.name: Divine Shield
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Sacred Shield at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 1 Dusk Relic, 2 Bird Feathers, 3 Ornamental Skulls and 100 Rupees.

tiers.name: Goddess Shield
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Divine Shield at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 4 Dusk Relics, 3 Bird Feathers, 3 Monster Horns, 1 Blue Bird Feather and 150 Rupees.

items.name: Hylian Shield
items.howTo: Once you've cured Lanayru with the Life Tree Fruit, talk to him in Lanayru Gorge to play the Thunder Dragon's Lightning Round. Win eight boss battles in a row, then stop to take your prize.
items.notes: Never breaks, and blocks fire and electricity. If you already have it, or your pouch and the Item Check are full, he pays 1,000 Rupees instead.
